fields.allowed_image_level_request: No new field; per-field corroboration of Hartung-derived fields by RSNA-50516 section headings (see note). Herts 2019 supports organ-system structure (abstract only).
fields.note: RSNA-50516 sections cover: liver.*, biliary.*, pancreas.*, spleen.*, adrenals.*, urinary (kidney-level: morphology, enhancement, masses, stones, collecting_system), GI.stomach, GI.duodenum and bowel caliber/wall/enhancement (Bowel and Stomach), GI.appendix, GI.fluid_collections and GI.free_fluid (Fluid), lower_chest.lung_bases, vascular.*, nodes.*; GI.peritoneal_omental_implants only via generic Mesentery/Peritoneum. NOT corroborated by RSNA-50516: urinary.ureters, urinary.bladder, urinary.bladder_wall_thickness, GI.distal_esophagus_GEJ, GI.free_air (ALIUS2023 step 15 Air and fluid only), lower_chest.pleural_effusion, lower_chest.pericardial_effusion
